title: New Saga's Jun Miura Launches New Manga on October 8
content: The official X/Twitter account for Overlap 's Comic Gardo manga website announced on Thursday that Jun Miura will launch a new manga titled Moto Shinryū, Chippoke na Ningen ni Tensei Shita Kedo Musō Shimasu (The Divine Dragon Remains Overpowered Despite Reincarnating as a Small Human) on the website on October 8.
author: ANN

content: The official X for the Tokyo Ravens light novel series announced on Friday that the series will end with its 18th volume, scheduled for release this Winter. title: Devils' Crest TV Anime Reveals More Cast, Ending Theme in 2nd Promo Video
content: The official website for Devils' Crest , the television anime of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest novel series, revealed the show's second promotional video on Friday. The video reveals and previews Soala 's ending theme song "ReaL." The website also revealed two more cast members.
author: ANN

title: 'Steel Ball Run: JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken' Announces Supporting Cast
content: The official X (formerly Twitter) account for the JoJo no Kimyou na Bouken ( JoJo's Bizarre Adventure ) announced the supporting cast for its seventh part, Steel Ball Run , on Friday.
author: MyAnimeList

title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 Releases Creditless Opening Ahead of Today's Premiere
content: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3 has released its creditless opening sequence featuring Yorushika’s new song “Beyond the Clouds, Only Me Downwind” ( Kumo wo Nuke Kazashimo e Watashi Dake ).
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Demons' Crest' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Ending Theme, Second Promo
content: The official website for the original net anime adaptation of Reki Kawahara 's Demons' Crest light novel unveiled a pair of additional cast, the theme songs, and second promotional video on Friday. The anime is scheduled to premiere on Amazon Prime Video on November 6.
author: MyAnimeList

title: WEBTOON Entertainment Names 2 Co-CEOs for Naver Webtoon
content: WEBTOON Entertainment's Korean subsidiary Naver Webtoon appointed WEBTOON Entertainment President Yongsoo Kim and Chief Administrative Officer Gyu-nam Kim as co-CEOs on October 1.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actor Naoki Bandō Dies at 69
content: Voice actor Naoki Bandō died on Monday, September 28. He was 69. Bandō's management agency Production Ace announced his death on Friday, adding that he had been undergoing medical treatment. Bandō voiced Robonyan and a large number of other characters in the Yo-kai Watch franchise .
author: ANN
